display.purpose: Oversized Barlow Condensed name strip and strongest page headings.

headline.purpose: Section, project, and interior-page headings in Barlow Condensed.

body.purpose: Navigation, project details, and reading text in DM Sans.

editorial.purpose: Centered About statement and longer editorial summaries in Georgia.

motion.name: ocean-current
motion.purpose: Animate SVG current lines and pointer ripple in the hero; stop when hidden, outside view, or reduced motion is enabled.

motion.name: gallery-scroll
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame per scroll/resize; tilt ±8deg, roll ±2.2deg, lift ±20px, travel ±58px, scale 1 to 0.965
motion.purpose: Move and slightly tilt project media through the sticky W/O/R/K stage.

motion.name: contact-radial
motion.purpose: Expand the circular contact reveal on hover or focus and rotate its orbit 45deg.

motion.name: link-feedback
motion.purpose: Short arrow and color feedback on links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stop drift and gallery transforms, return to the static current field, and minimize transitions.

narrative.overview:
The portfolio opens with a full-width animated current field and Aman's name in a monumental title strip. Fine framing and ruled bands keep the ocean palette composed. A compact About panel leads into a scroll-linked project stage where repeated W/O/R/K lettering sits behind alternating project media. The Projects archive uses a two-column catalogue; experience is presented as four compact rows, and contact closes with a radial invitation.

The typography balances Barlow Condensed, DM Sans, and Georgia. Real project captures and repository figures sit alongside authored interface studies, with provenance preserved in accessible descriptions and the project media documentation.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ocean surfaces, icy text, cyan signals, and a fine viewport frame.
Oversized Barlow Condensed lettering, direct DM Sans details, and Georgia editorial leads.
A moving current field and scroll-linked media planes create the motion system.
Authentic project media and relevant authored studies replace generic diagrams.

rules.name: The Current Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks interaction and visual direction; use it sparingly against the ocean palette.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for display, DM Sans for utility and reading, and Georgia for editorial emphasis.

rules.name: The Clear Media Rule
rules.body: Keep project images free of bottom caption bars. Preserve provenance in accessible descriptions and project media documentation; let authored previews grow naturally.

dos: Do use the current ocean, deep, work-stage, panel, ice, and cyan colors.
Do use square frames, ruled section divisions, and the continuous viewport border.
Do preserve source credits in documentation and accessible descriptions without visible caption bars.
Do keep the only public email as amancodinghere@gmail.com.
Do preserve keyboard access and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't invent metrics, model results, patient details, product screenshots, or source links.
Don't add source or demo links for Job Advertisement Information Extraction or Toohak.
Don't reintroduce generic abstract project diagrams when project media or a labelled study is available.
Don't replace the framed geometry with pill controls, rounded cards, or generic shadow-heavy surfaces.

components.name: Framed Header
components.description: Ruled desktop header with a compact nameplate, main navigation, and GitHub link.
components.html:
AMAN SHARMASoftware engineering · Sydney
WorkAboutExperienceContact
components.css: .ds-header { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.23); border-top: 0; background: #062a41; color: #effafb; font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding-inline: 20px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand b { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-brand span { color: #a5c2cb; font-size: 10px; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; } .ds-header nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; padding-inline: 18px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.23); color: #a5c2cb; font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: color .18s, background .18s; } .ds-header nav a:hover, .ds-header nav a:focus-visible { color: #effafb; background: rgba(103,212,226,.07); } .ds-header nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67d4e2; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Current Field
components.description: Full-width hero field for the visible SVG current lines and pointer response.
components.css: .ds-current-field { height: 34vh; min-height: 210px; overflow: hidden; background: #0a3a55; } .ds-current-field svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: none; stroke: #67d4e2; stroke-opacity: .64; stroke-width: 1; }

components.name: Name Strip
components.description: Monumental uppercase name strip below the hero current field.
components.css: .ds-name-strip { padding: 12px 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.23); } .ds-name-strip h1 { margin: 0; color: #effafb; font: 900 clamp(84px, 17.2vw, 286px)/.76 'Barlow Condensed', Impact, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.045em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Centered About Panel
components.description: Compact centered editorial statement between the name strip and work stage.
components.html:
ABOUT

I’m a software engineering student at UNSW, building across software and machine learning.
components.css: .ds-about { width: min(100%, 700px); margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(30px, 5vw, 62px) clamp(22px, 5vw, 64px); border-inline: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.43); background: #062a41; text-align: center; } .ds-about h2 { margin: 0 0 22px; color: #effafb; font: 700 12px/1 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-about p { margin: 0; color: #effafb; font: 400 clamp(27px, 3.3vw, 42px)/1.28 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-about em { color: #67d4e2; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Project Media Frame
components.description: Square-corner frame for a project capture, without a bottom caption bar.
components.css: .ds-project-media { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.43); background: #0b3b55; color: #effafb; } .ds-project-media img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1.6 / 1; object-fit: cover; }

components.name: Compact Experience Row
components.description: Three-column period, role, and organization row separated by fine rules.
components.html: May 2026 – PresentSoftware Engineer – PerceptionsUNSWim Robotics, UNSW
components.css: .ds-experience { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(110px,.6fr) 1.1fr 1fr; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; padding: 15px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.23); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195,230,237,.23); color: #a5c2cb; font: 400 11px/1.5 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-experience b { color: #effafb; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Radial Contact Invitation
components.description: Large mail link with a pale circle that expands on hover or keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-contact-invitation { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; overflow: hidden; padding: 20px 0; color: #effafb; text-decoration: none; } .ds-contact-invitation::before { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: #effafb; clip-path: circle(0% at 88% 50%); content: ''; transition: clip-path .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-contact-invitation:hover::before, .ds-contact-invitation:focus-visible::before { clip-path: circle(115% at 88% 50%); } .ds-contact-invitation h2 { margin: 0; font: 900 clamp(76px,16vw,240px)/.7 'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.06em; transition: color .25s; } .ds-contact-invitation span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: clamp(90px,16vw,220px); aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-size: clamp(28px,5vw,60px); transition: color .25s,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-contact-invitation:hover h2, .ds-contact-invitation:focus-visible h2, .ds-contact-invitation:hover span, .ds-contact-invitation:focus-visible span { color: #082f49; } .ds-contact-invitation:hover span, .ds-contact-invitation:focus-visible span { transform: rotate(45deg); }
